Although we received a shipment of HALEU feedstock in December 2025, future operations will continue to depend on customer procurement, supply availability, regulatory authorization and transportation of feedstock to us.

Our future operating results will also depend on the mix of revenue derived from our fuel development work, commercial fuel sales, specialty material supply arrangements and government-related projects, which may have different margin and working capital characteristics.
We expect our future performance to depend on our ability to improve throughput, yield and capacity utilization and to scale manufacturing efficiently.
